titre: Each new GTA moves the series closer and closer to the original Mafia, the open-world game that bettered Rockstar

articles.titre: Each new GTA moves the series closer and closer to the original Mafia, the open-world game that bettered Rockstar
articles.resume: This week sees the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 , the open-world crime 'em up that's been in development for at least eight years and has been waited on by fans for even longer. Naturally, over on PC we're still waiting for a port to be announced, let alone a release date to circle in our calendars. But, as happens whenever a new GTA is on the horizon, I think about Mafia: City of Lost Heaven .…
